thread:
Anya: quick design review — can we land the breadcrumb ellipsis + deeplink state stuff today?
Mateo: depends. what exactly needs to be preserved in the url?
Anya: selected workspace + model + open right-panel + any filter/query state (eg evalFilter=failed). also if user has a flyout open (compare modal) we want a shareable link that restores it.
Samir: ellipsizing long model names in the middle sounds good, but we need an a11y announcement for screen readers when crumbs change so it doesn't feel abrupt.
Eva: +1 on an aria-live approach. suggestion: aria-live="polite" with text like "Breadcrumb: workspace › models › run-123" whenever the path stabilizes.
Mateo: routing options i sketched:
```
/workspaces/:wsId/models/:modelId?panel=evals&panelState=open&filter=failed#compare=run123
```
or keep heavy state in session and expose a short stateHash in the query to avoid ultra-long urls. also consider using history.replaceState to avoid noisy back-button behaviour.
Jun: implementation concern — restoring panelState=open could cause extra service calls (runtime preview). fallback plan needed if the panel load fails.
Anya: fallback: try restore -> on timeout/500 fall back silently and show toast: "Couldn't restore panel — opened default view." :warning:
Samir: copy nit: prefer exactly that shorter toast. avoids "could not" phrasing.
Eva: keyboard/focus flow note: if deep link opens a flyout, focus MUST move into the flyout and land on the first interactive element; also announce "Comparison panel opened" (aria-live) so non-visual users are oriented.
Mateo: dev note: encode ephemeral UI state in query only, keep the path semantic. for long filter sets, hash -> stateHash=abc123 and resolve server-side or via short client store.
Anya: design asks: show full crumb on hover (tooltip) and provide aria-label with full path for SRs. when path gets ellipsized show an affordance to copy full path.
Jun: i'll add a route guard that strips unknown/legacy params and normalizes duplicates. will also ensure hash fallback to avoid back-stack noise.
Anya: can i get final sign-off on copy + a11y strings before i update figma?
Mateo: lgtm for copy, small tweak: use em-dash punctuation in the toast, matches console tone.
Samir: lgtm for a11y; i'll draft NVDA/VoiceOver test cases.
Eva: i'll own the accessibility brief and test matrix and post here when ready.
nav-bot: deploy-preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.com/console/1719901112 — please smoke test links :rocket:
Anya: thanks all — i'll merge the spec and open PRs for frontend + runtime tweaks. will ping when PRs are up. :smile:
